newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates says phasing out cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Emirates says phasing out cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: Dubai's Emirates airline is phasing out the cargo fuel surcharge applied since last November, cargo revenue optimisation manager Pradeep Kumar said.
"Emirates will withdraw the fuel surcharge from the United Arab Emirates market with effect from April 16," Kumar told Reuters on Tuesday.
Since November Emirates has applied a 10 U.S. cent per kilo surcharge on long-haul flights and a five cent surcharge on short-haul routes.
Kumar said Emirates had dropped the surcharge on flights out of Germany and Switzerland on April 13.
"For the UK we are withdrawing with effect from April 20," he said, adding the scrapping of the surcharge out of Singapore was "imminent".

"This is in line with the promise we made to the industry that the moment the fuel price touches pre-July 1996 levels, we would withdraw the surcharge," Kumar added. - Hilary Gush, Dubai Newsroom +9714-6071220
